From Victim to Fighter

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Summary:
On October 23rd 2007 when he was 27 years old Darren was shot and stabbed at a house robbery. His father found him and rushed him to hospital where he narrowly survived. He was an adrenaline junky, fitness freak who overnight become paralyzed from the waist down. After totally giving up and falling into a pit of despair Darren decided he was going to go back to doing everything he was doing before only differently.
He now climbs ropes, kickboxes and trains harder than any able bodied person. He just does it all in his wheelchair. He really is an inspiration to anyone feeling sorry for themselves after a crappy COVID year

He has CCTV footage from the night of the robbery and we can film his insane life with him doing all the crazy things

Videos and photos from his Instagram

Script:


Start with kickboxing video part 1
He was a kickboxing champion, a Lions 7 rugby player. Darren Thomas was young, fit, happy, successful and dating the girl of his dreams. He had it all.
Kickboxing video – winner Darren Thomas
But then two nights after South Africa won the world cup in 2007 everything changed. – Visually this doesn’t work. Is there anything else we can use here? Maybe we can look when we zoom

00:02:41:08 - 00:03:12:19
it was Tuesday, three
o'clock in the morning
I had a little puppy that I bought from my girlfriend and she was staying with me. It woke me up
and I thought I heard things, but I thought I was being paranoid
(BUT)they were ready in the in the garden walking around

Three men had entered his parents property and Darryn was violently attacked during an armed robbery. He was 27 at the time.

00:03:39:14 - 00:03:51:08
my dad found me. lying in the room. the guys had come in. There must've been a scuffle. I had scratches and bruises all left my arms.
00:03:52:21 - 00:04:01:08
the one guy stabbed me in the head with a screwdriver. So I stabbed me the side and the other guy shot me point blank in the chest.
00:04:02:17 - 00:04:21:09
The bullet missed my heart by a millimeter because as he fired my heart, contracted the bullet, hit my lung, ruptured my lung, and then it hit my spine and the bone fragments went into the spinal cord. So so that that's what that's what caused the damage

Darryn woke up in the hospital and was told that he was now a C5 paraplegic, basically he was paralysed from the chest down

00:08:02:28 - 00:08:36:04
I've always believed and so I believe that each day would be better and that I was going to get up and walk out of that hospital

LINK: IT WAS SOMETHING LIKE THIS Overnight Darren went from kickboxing in SA Champs, riding superbikes, jetski’ing and training for hours in the gym to being paralyzed from the chest down. His life as he knew it was over.

00:13:13:20 - 00:13:40:10
I lost my identity, you know, because I was a rugby player. I played for the Lions Sevens and I had gone to kickboxing tournaments. I've gone to say champs. And, you know, I was that was me. You know, I was active and it was what I did. And so with this, what would I do? You know, who would I be? And that was a tough thing to deal with.

At the time of the Attack Darryn had been dating Lauren Saunders for about two years. And they had to face a whole new reality

she was incredible because she she stuck around, you know, and and there were times when I told her to leave and she. You told it to me. Yeah. I think it was just it was tough.
That was She had a lot going for, you
knowshe was she studied law and she had done her exams and she was doing articles.
And so she basically dropped to be there by my side and every day at the rehab having her the day by day, you know, I think the biggest thing for me is and I always get emotional about it, but, you know, she was there through the toughest of the times.

Darren went down a dark path after the attack, but eventually he decided to start LIVing again and for the next few years he has clawed his way back

Sequence
BOXING BOXING
pASS WEIGHTS HOLD ME FROM BEHIND
I HAVE TO TRAIN HARDER

After going through the most intense journey together Darryn and Lauren finally got married and did their first dance in a wheelchair

Upsound from wedding

They had two amazing miracle babies and now Darryn is back to being stronger than ever before

I'm my biggest competition. So I set the bar pretty high. And so I need to achieve things. to feel like I'm getting somewhere. I want to do when people say, wow, you know, not and it's not what the gods do.
Something really cool for a guy in a wheelchair, I want to be like, wow, that guy did something really cool just because.

PULL UPS on the rope – upsound of video

Strapped to his wheelchair Darren uses pure arm strength to push his body harder and further than most able bodied people. Just watching him makes me realise how the mind is so much stronger than we will ever know!

UPSOUND – VIDEO OF HIM ROPE CLIMBING

00:21:11:00 - 00:21:45:28
the gym was always my therapy
00:22:07:21 - 00:22:40:04
So I'll jump on a bench and people would think, you can't do it. But again, something and someone tells me that I can't it's when I'm when I say that I can, you know, when I want to do it more


With his daughter and son setting the pace Darren is training to start competing in races again

Family at the table – Son: I can run the fastest, daughter: daddy can wheel the fastest

Lauren:
I just look at him every day, and I think he's such an inspiration to me because he just gets up, has a smile on his face, he works so hard for his family, he never complains.
And when I'm feeling lazy, I'm like, oh, well, if Darren can do it, I can dance, you know?


00:30:58:08 - 00:31:09:16
up and down. It's been a tough year for many of our people who've lost loved ones financially in dire straits.
00:31:10:16 - 00:31:15:05
But do you think some of us sweat the small stuff?


00:32:13:21 - 00:32:47:24
You know, my biggest thing in life now is it doesn't matter all. We all want to be successful. It doesn't matter how much money you have, but it's the people that are around you and the people that you have that's going to matter the most. You know, I was lying in a hospital bed and not much money in the world could have changed my situation. But the people that were there, that they were the ones that kept me going, you know, people that loved me and that I that I loved and cared for.
